{{Quote|All systems failure! I repeat&mdash;|Grievous, following the activation of an ion bomb on the ''Martyr''|<ref name="Eyes" />}}
The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Martyr]]'' '''crashed''' on the [[Jenuwaa Sea]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It was arranged by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], and [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] in order to secure the allegiance of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
